Vata.recommendation: Focus on warm, grounding, and oily foods. Soups, stews, and root vegetables are ideal.
menu: Breakfast: Warm oatmeal with ghee and cooked apples.
Lunch: Kitchari or hearty root vegetable stew.
Dinner: Sweet potato soup with a side of warm grains.

Pitta.recommendation: Focus on cooling, hydrating, and sweet foods. Avoid hot spices.
menu: Breakfast: Coconut water and fresh sweet fruits (melons).
Lunch: Cooling cucumber salad and basmati rice.
Dinner: Light zucchini soup with mint and coriander.

Kapha.recommendation: Focus on light, dry, and warming foods. Incorporate spices.
menu: Breakfast: Stewed apples with cinnamon and ginger tea.
Lunch: Quinoa with steamed leafy greens and black pepper.
Dinner: Light vegetable broth or lentil soup.

Balanced.recommendation: Adjust your diet slightly based on the current season, maintaining a balance of all six tastes.
menu: Breakfast: Seasonal fruits and light grains.
Lunch: Balanced plate with cooked vegetables, grains, and protein.
Dinner: Lighter meal, mostly vegetables and soup.

timing.Vata: Eat small, regular meals. Do not skip meals. Best times: 8 AM, 12 PM, 6 PM.
timing.Pitta: Eat substantial meals at regular times. Strongest digestion is at noon. Best times: 7 AM, 12 PM, 6 PM.
timing.Kapha: Light breakfast or skip it. Main meal at lunch. Light early dinner. Best times: 10 AM, 2 PM, 6 PM.
timing.Balanced: Eat when naturally hungry, typically 3 meals a day. Best times: 8 AM, 1 PM, 7 PM.
